scope: Extend generated dimension transaction coverage to ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION across all seven target revisions and both DXF encodings.

source.kind: records authored from scratch in memory and serialized beneath the build test directory
profiles: ARC_DIMENSION with nondefault center and extension points, partial-arc state, leader points, and angles
LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION with nondefault center, chord, overridden center, jog point, and jog angle
seven standard concrete DIMENSION subtypes and current/legacy dynamic-constraint controls in the same generated drawing

implementation.method: Prime each version and encoding with an untracked write, measure allocations in the clean output write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured allocation, require destination and caller-state rollback, retry with the same codec, compare exact clean bytes, and freshly read typed standard/custom dimension callbacks and selected subtype fields.

limitations: Generated DXF transaction and self-readback evidence only; producer interoperability, independent semantics, and native rendering are not qualified.
This exercises the generated ARC_DIMENSION partial-arc/leader profile and one LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION jog profile; other producer variants and drawing-level semantic behavior remain unqualified.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: Generated ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION now have whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation rollback, caller-state preservation, same-codec retry, byte-identical clean output, and typed readback across AC1014/AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032.
planImpact.remainingP6G: P6-G remains open for public-writer inventory reconciliation, remaining direct routes and compound variants, and uncovered variable-size OBJECTS builders.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 299 completed slices and 34 remaining packages: 299/(299+34)=89.8%; equal-weight count, not effort-weighted.
